summary: Fixed migration 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metre rounding) and 0013 (no concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 collectors, deferred taxa, TS/SD basis codes). A fresh build passes all checks, and an upgraded 1.6.0 copy has the same schema and rows.
